_comment: Financial-year super parameters. charge_percentage is SGAA s 17A(2). max_contributions_base is annual per employer from 1 Jul 2026 (s 10A(5): concessional cap x 100 / charge percentage, rounded down to the nearest $10), where it was quarterly under the old law.

2026-27.source: ATO, Maximum contribution base (updated 10 Aug 2026), read directly: $270,830 annual per employer for 2026-27. The page states the statutory formula of the $32,500 concessional cap multiplied by 100/12 and rounded down to the nearest $10. Cross-checked against the ATO Super guarantee rates and thresholds table.
